query:
UPDATE users
            SET display_name = $2,
                avatar_url = $3,
                onboarding_step = NULLIF(
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(onboarding_step, -1), COALESCE($4::smallint, -1)),
                    -1
                ),
                onboarding_skipped = COALESCE($5::boolean, onboarding_skipped)
            WHERE id = $1
